newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cityhold buys Vaal Mac for 20.64 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Cityhold buys Vaal Mac for 20.64 mln rand.

text.p: South African firms City Investment Holdings Ltd and Spicer-Mitchell Holdings Ltd said on Monday Cityhold is to acquire the Vaal Mac Group for 20.64 million rand with effect from April 1, 1996.
The purchase consideration wil be settled as follows:
- renounceable letters of allotment in respect of 14.6 million Cityhold ordinary shares at 128 cents per share issued to the Vaal Mac Group.

- the Vaal Mac group will renounce these renounceable letters of allotment in favour of Spicer-Mitchell who will purchase them and settle the purchase price by the issue of 19.5 million ordinary Spicer-Mitchell shares at 96 cents per share to the Vaal Mac Group.

- by March 31, 1997, Cityhold will issue a further 1.5 million Cityhold renounceable letters of allotment at 128 cents per share to the Vaal Mac group, who will renounce these letters of allotment in favour of Spicer-Mitchell for the issue of two million Spicer-Mitchell ordinary shares at 96 cents per share to the Vaal Mac Group.

The Vaal Mac Group is an established group of engineering companies focusing on the provision of engineering services, the manufacture and refurbishment of rollers and of steel product production equipment, and the manufacture and distribution of springs, fasteners and allied products.
The companies said that the authorised share capital of Spicer-Mitchell would be increased to 120 million ordinary shares of one cent each from 60 million ordinary shares of one cent each.
The authorised share capital of Cityhold would also be raised to 120 million ordibnary shares of one cent each from 66 million ordinary shares of one cent each.
